title: Bounded 3D/4D practice Explorer
note: Local launch: Godot game bootstrap → Main Menu → Explorer (E). Piece selector and Replace piece (Space; P alias) use the native catalogue and preserve view/queue; Retry restores the selected piece. Camera/basis/reset and W-key ordering retain pane/helper nodes; dimension changes retain Explorer tabs and controls. View opens first with all six 4D view planes, including XY/YZ/YW; Piece controls are secondary, raw debug readouts are hidden. VIEW keycaps are clickable and show the live bindings for every camera rotation, including Shift+1–6 for XY/YZ/YW; the lower object helper remains, with no separate lower VIEW copy. Rejection feedback scrolls within a font-relative allocation; frame-by-frame geometry/fit regression covers action updates. Z/X move up/down. Settings and Designer preference menus use compact typography and spacing. QA: docs/plans/bounded_practice_explorer.md. Novice acceptance and EXPLORER_LEARNING_READY remain pending.
